name: loihi
display_name: Intel Loihi 1 (14 nm, Davies 2018): 128 cores, dense equivalent 128 x 1024

faithfulness.note: Loihi's per-core capacity is a synaptic memory (128 KB) with fan-in and fan-out list limits (davies2018loihi p89); the registered geometry is its dense equivalent until a memory-bound core type exists (CH-B2).
